name: send_alert
description: Dispatch an immediate multi-channel notification (Mobile Push, Slack, Telegram, WhatsApp, Email, Webhook) via AlertHub.

name: schedule_alert
description: Schedule a one-time or recurring future reminder via AlertHub at least 20 minutes in the future.

name: list_recent_events
description: Retrieve up to 20 of the user's most recent AlertHub events to verify delivery or inspect recent errors.

name: list_profiles
description: Retrieve the users available AlertHub profiles (older first, max 20) to decide which one to use for the notification(s).
